_comment: Who the quest givers are. Keyed by the game's own npc_id (the same id means the same character on every map, which is what lets one character be a thread through the whole world). 'name' is the name tab shown in the conversation box; 'look' says what the sprite shows (checked on a contact sheet of the sprites, 2026-10-15); 'voice' is how they talk. Named Digimon and the named shopkeepers carry the names the game gives them (merchants.json, map names); everyone else is a role described from the sprite, because the disc gives them no names. Everything a character says in a quest is new writing, not game text. See docs/quests-bible.md.

_threads._comment: Recurring characters who can carry a storyline across many places. Each is an npc_id that appears in many towns, so one thread can walk the player through the world.
_threads.Old Woman: rumours: always heard something about the next place; her quests point somewhere new
_threads.Old Man: legends and riddles: sends the player to look at a landmark and answer what they saw
_threads.Geek: data: wants a species met, a form learned, a count of something
_threads.Girl: cards and swaps: duels and collecting
_threads.Boy: dares and growing up: fights, levels, proving himself
_threads.Office Worker: errands: carries messages and parcels between towns
_threads.Yellow Coat: the rival: appears in many places, challenges you again and again
_threads.Black Hat: secrets: sells hints, then asks a favour that turns out bigger than it sounded
